it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e passou a comandar a prefeitura depois que Daniel Santos renunciou ao cargo, em 02/04/2026, para disputar a eleição de 2026 para governador do Pará. A renúncia foi publicada no Diário Oficial do município de 03/04/2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and took charge of the city government after Mayor Daniel Santos resigned on April 2, 2026, to run for governor of Pará state in the 2026 election. The resignation was published in the city's Official Gazette on April 3, 2026.
